tireless-reveler.summary: When an ally within 60 ft whom you can see spends Heroic Inspiration, gain Heroic Inspiration if you don't have it. PB times per Short or Long Rest.

vampire-hunter.summary: Hard to pin down and hardened against life-draining harm.

Adroit Escape.summary: Advantage on checks to break free of nonmagical restraints or a grapple.

Vitality Ward.summary: Reaction on taking Necrotic damage: roll PB d6s and cut the damage by the total. Once per Short or Long Rest.

vampires-plaything.summary: A former vampire's thrall who learned to brew remedies and slip away.

Decanting.summary: On finishing a Long Rest, fill an empty vial or flask with a Potion of Healing or an Antitoxin; it vanishes at the end of your next Long Rest.

Timely Retreat.summary: Bonus Action: Dash or Disengage. PB times per Long Rest.

Vampiric Connection.summary: While on the same plane, your old vampire master (fate set by the DM) can speak to you telepathically, and you may let it share your senses.

bloodlust.summary: Heal by drawing on wounded foes and recover more reliably.

Powerful Recovery.summary: Hit Point Dice rolled for healing count 1s and 2s as 3.

Sanguine Feast.summary: Once per turn when your attack roll hits a Bloodied creature that's neither Construct nor Undead, spend and roll a Hit Point Die to heal the roll + CON modifier. PB times per Long Rest.

bomber.summary: Throw flasks and thrown weapons farther and straighter.

Far Lobber.summary: A vial or flask thrown with the Attack action can target a creature or object you see within 40 ft.

Long Shots.summary: No Disadvantage for long range with Thrown weapons.

cloying-mists.summary: Conjure clinging fog that douses flames and slows enemies.

Arise, Fog.summary: Fog Cloud is always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots, using the ability you raised.

Grasping Mist.summary: Your Fog Cloud puts out nonmagical fires inside it and gives non-allies in it -5 ft Speed.

delicious-pain.summary: Shrug off physical blows after the first one lands.

Toughened Flesh.summary: Reaction right after taking Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage: Resistance to all three until your next turn starts. Once per Short or Long Rest.

light-bringer.summary: Wield sunlight against the dark and heal in it.

Sacred Magic.summary: Learn Light (no Material components), or another Cleric cantrip if you already know it, cast with the ability you raised.

Solar Luminance.summary: Make one casting of Light shed sunlight. Once per Long Rest.

Sun’s Healing.summary: Bonus Action in sunlight: spend and roll a Hit Point Die, healing the roll. Once per Short or Long Rest.

love-bites.summary: Your strikes leave foes smitten for a moment.

Endearing Pain.summary: Bonus Action right after damaging a creature with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike: it's Charmed until your next turn starts or you or an ally damages it. Once per Short or Long Rest.

Necrosis.summary: When you roll Necrotic damage, one creature it hits is Poisoned until your next turn starts. Once per Short or Long Rest.

rebuke.summary: Radiant harm that knocks foes down.

Radiant Strike.summary: When you roll Radiant damage, one Huge or smaller creature it hits falls Prone. Once per Short or Long Rest.

treacherous-allure.summary: Charm others, then strike them while they trust you.

Enchanting Presence.summary: Charm Person is always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots, using the ability you raised.

Inevitable Betrayal.summary: Advantage on attack rolls against Charmed creatures.

vampire-touched.summary: A taste of vampiric magic: wall-crawling and a minor beguiling spell.

Vampire Magic.summary: Spider Climb and a level 1 Enchantment or Illusion spell of your choice are always prepared; each can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot (Spider Climb on yourself only), or with slots, using the ability you raised.

choices.label: Level 1 Enchantment or Illusion spell (free once per Long Rest)

boon-of-blazing-dawn.summary: Become a vessel of sunlight: immune to Radiant, with weapon blows that blaze.

Blazing Strike.summary: Weapon hits can deal Radiant damage in place of their usual type.

Burst of Sunlight.summary: Once per turn on a hit with Radiant damage, shine sunlight around you (Bright 30 ft, Dim 30 ft more) until your next turn starts.

Shadowy Stretch.summary: Taking the Attack action adds 10 ft to your Melee weapon reach until your turn ends.

boon-of-misty-escape.summary: Escape death by turning to mist.

Gaseous Form.summary: When dropped to 0 HP but not killed outright, go to 1 HP and cast Gaseous Form on yourself for free with no action: Fly Speed 20 ft and regain 10 HP at the start of each of your turns while it lasts. Uses the ability you raised; once per Long Rest.
